rules.name: EMA trend pullback resumption
rules.rule: EMA50>EMA200 and EMA200>lag24; prior close below EMA20 and prior low<=EMA20; current close above EMA20 and prior high; mirror short

rules.name: Compressed range breakout
rules.rule: prior12 high-low<=4 priorATR; close first crosses prior12 extreme; volume>=1.25 prior24 median; EMA50/200 aligned; mirror

rules.name: Flat-market Keltner reclaim
rules.rule: ADX<20; abs(EMA50-lag24)/ATR<1; close reclaims EMA50-2ATR after previous close below its band; mirror upper

rules.name: RSI2 trend reset
rules.rule: EMA50/200 aligned and close beyond EMA200; previous3 RSI2 min<10 and current cross above30; mirror max>90 cross below70

rules.name: Volume impulse continuation
rules.rule: body 1..3ATR; volume>=2 prior24 median; bullish close upper20% with EMA50>200, mirror short

rules.name: BTC-relative momentum
rules.rule: alt24hreturn-BTC24hreturn>.01; EMA50>200, close>EMA50, first close through prior6 high, volume>=1.25 prior24 median; mirror; BTCexcluded

risk_model_limit: unchanged BT.run compounds equity-based risk, initial$8 not fixed live$8; candidate activation requires actual account-fit check
no_holdout_claim: ALL historical data consumed DEV; 2025 split and chronological halfyears are diagnostic stability checks, not fresh sealed holdout
trial_accounting: six additional frozen configurations in previously researched families, not six independently novel families; all outcomes retained; no parameter changes based on results
priority_order: cohort9 worst15 all six first, then cost/path ladders; long8 secondary

economics_screen.drawdown: report R/%/duration and label; no blanket DD rejection
economics_screen.frequency_basket_target: at least5 closes/week after shared-account caps; solo frequency is not additive proof

activation: No auto qualification from historical screen; independent signal/execution/cost parity, native-or-explicitstress funding, account4 fixedrisk/minimum sizing, shared-basket interaction, protective stop/rollback testnet gates; no account1-3 action
